common.authority: All balances, positions, cost basis, lifecycle state, digests, snapshots, and reconciliation outcomes shown here come from the backend. The browser presents values and submits explicit inputs; it does not calculate financial truth.

list.title: Paper Accounts
list.description: Inspect durable account identities and backend-authored state in deterministic API order.
list.emptyMessage: No durable account matches the explicit filters.

create.title: Create Paper Account
create.description: Submit account identity, base currency, initial cash, and actor through the generated API contract.
create.authority: Initial cash is an explicit input. Only the backend validates it, creates the immutable creation event and posting, and returns the authoritative account and projection.
create.decimalHelp: Enter the exact canonical decimal string expected by the backend. The browser does not round or normalize it.
create.confirmation: I understand this submits an explicit durable account-creation command; it does not place orders or execute trades.

validation.title: Correct the explicit input
validation.noRequest: No request was sent. Every draft value remains available.
validation.displayName: Display name must be normalized and contain 1–200 characters.
validation.baseCurrency: Base currency must contain exactly three ASCII letters.
validation.decimal: Enter a canonical fixed-point decimal string without exponent notation or trailing zeroes.
validation.actor: Actor must be normalized and contain 1–512 characters.
validation.idempotencyKey: Idempotency-Key must be normalized and contain 1–128 characters.
validation.confirmation: Confirm the durable, non-executing account-creation boundary.
validation.operation: Complete every required field with normalized text, an explicit choice, canonical decimal values, and UTC timestamps where supplied.

detail.loading: Loading account, projection, and immutable ledger.
detail.ledgerFailureTitle: Additional ledger events could not be loaded
detail.accountAuthorityDescription: The compact durable record and exact event-chain anchors returned by the backend.
detail.projectionAuthorityDescription: A validated replaceable cache derived by backend ledger replay. The browser does not rebuild or repair it.
detail.noPositions: The backend returned no current position projections.
detail.noApprovedEvidence: The backend returned no approved portfolio-review references.

ledger.title: Immutable ledger timeline
ledger.description: Events and postings appear in the exact contiguous sequence returned by the backend. No browser-side balance or position calculation is performed.

operations.title: Explicit account operations
operations.description: Each form submits one generated-contract command with the currently displayed backend version.
operations.backendDecides: The browser does not infer lifecycle eligibility, sufficient cash, position invariants, cost basis, or M30 approval. A conflict is preserved as an auditable backend outcome; refresh before deciding whether to retry.

cash.title: Cash movement
cash.description: Submit one exact requested amount and movement type. The backend owns sign semantics and available-cash validation.

position.title: Position adjustment
position.description: Submit exact signed quantity and aggregate cost-basis deltas. This is not an order, fill, price, PnL, or execution workflow.

evidence.title: Link approved M30 evidence
evidence.description: Reference one approved portfolio review. Evidence remains governance provenance and never becomes cash, holdings, or ledger authority.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle action
lifecycle.description: Choose one explicit action. The backend alone decides whether the transition is eligible.
lifecycle.confirmation: I understand this is an account lifecycle command only and does not authorize trading or execution.

evidenceOperations.title: Snapshot and reconciliation evidence
evidenceOperations.description: Create immutable derived evidence against the exact displayed account version and chain anchors. These operations do not repair projections or add ledger events.

snapshot.title: Create snapshot
snapshot.description: Capture the backend replayed projection as immutable evidence.

reconciliation.title: Create reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Compare the persisted candidate projection with backend replay authority without repairing it.
